Alex S.: Hey team — traveling and my child's specialist appt is tomorrow morning but I can't find our insurance ID card. Portal shows Dr. Lee as OON for some reason. Can People Ops help with a temporary ID or direct-billing confirmation? cc @Priya
Priya (People Ops): Hi Alex — sorry to hear that. Which Redwood plan are you on and do you see a member ID anywhere in the app? If not we can generate a temp ID and reach out to the provider billing office.
Alex S.: I’m on Redwood Standard PPO. No member ID in the wallet right now. Appt is 9am local tomorrow (3/28). The directory search shows Dr. Lee in-network for our zip, so not sure why the portal flagged OON :grimacing:
Maria G.: FWIW I ran into this last month — directory sync delay. We called the clinic billing line and they accepted a verification email from People Ops and billed directly. Priya, is that still the process?
Benefits Bot: Auto-reply — Temporary member ID PDF created for Alex S. (token 1899999999). Download: https://benefits.redwood.internal/temp-id/1899999999 (expires in 72h).
Priya (People Ops): Thanks Maria. Alex — I'll send the temp ID to the provider billing address and include the plan verbiage and verification note so they can direct-bill. If they refuse OON at checkout we will file a retro in-network review and help with claims. Can you share the clinic billing email or number?
Alex S.: Thanks!! Clinic billing email is billing@leeclinic.example. Forwarded the temp ID link to them and copied you. Will update here if they confirm. Really appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
